spec.prompt: Falsy JSON payloads are dropped: inject(dispatch, { method: 'POST', url: '/', payload: 0 }) sends an empty body with no content-type, and so does payload: false, while payload: 1 and payload: true are sent as JSON. Send 0 and false the same way as other non-string values (JSON body, content-type application/json, content-length), whether given as payload or as body. undefined and null still mean no payload, and string, buffer and object payloads are unchanged.
spec.requirement: A payload (or body) of 0 or false is serialized like any other non-string, non-buffer, non-stream value: JSON.stringify gives '0' / 'false', content-type defaults to application/json, content-length is set. undefined and null still mean no payload; payload takes precedence over body as before; string, buffer and stream payloads are unchanged.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
provenance.notes: Real behaviour of light-my-request v6.6.0 (payload chosen and serialized by truthiness).
